concept.title: Second-hand goods and shopping help
concept.shortdesc: Getting pre-loved clothes and household goods, and help with shopping and errands.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Receiving, donating or swapping pre-loved clothing, furniture and household items, including upcycling and swap shops.
: Getting help with the weekly shop, errands or shopping trips, and shopping at community or charity shops.
